properties.name: Ayodhya
properties.text_clue: Capital of Kosala, a great country on the bank of the Sarayu
properties.identification: Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh: Ram Janmabhoomi site on the right bank of the Sarayu (Ghaghara)
properties.paleo_note: Town on a stable Pleistocene upland; the Sarayu (Ghaghara) channel swings 4-7 km within its meander belt, so the river bank of Valmiki's time is uncertain by about ±5-7 km

properties.name: Shringaverapura
properties.text_clue: Guha's town on the Ganga where Rama crossed the river
properties.identification: Shringverpur (Singraur), Prayagraj district: excavated site on the Ganga bank
properties.paleo_note: No river shift documented: still on the Ganga's left bank; occupation TL-dated from c. 1035-875 BCE

properties.name: Prayaga (Bharadvaja's ashram)
properties.text_clue: Bharadvaja's hermitage at the joining (sandhi) of the Ganga and Yamuna, reached by evening
properties.identification: Bharadwaj Ashram, Colonelganj, Prayagraj (proxy: Bharadwaj Park); confluence = Triveni Sangam
properties.paleo_note: The confluence point moves seasonally and the Ganga moved west toward the fort in 1975-2000; the 'sandhi' is good to about ±1-2 km

properties.name: Prayaga (Bharadvaja's ashram) — alternative: Triveni Sangam (confluence point, migrates seasonally)
Chitrakuta
properties.text_clue: Hill 'ten krosha from here' (Prayaga) with the Mandakini river below it
properties.identification: Kamadgiri hill, Chitrakoot (Kamta Nath temple); Mandakini at Ramghat

properties.name: Chitrakuta — alternative: Ramghat on the Mandakini
Atri and Anasuya's ashram
properties.text_clue: Hermitage of Atri and Anasuya after leaving Chitrakuta
properties.identification: Sati Anusuya ashram, Chitrakoot

properties.name: Sharabhanga's ashram
properties.text_clue: Hermitage in the Dandaka forest
properties.identification: Sarbhanga Ashram village, Satna district (village-centre proxy)

properties.name: Panchavati
properties.text_clue: Two yojanas from Agastya's ashram, near the Godavari, by a madhuka forest and a hill
properties.identification: Panchavati, Nashik (Sita Gufa / Kalaram temple) on the Godavari
properties.paleo_note: Godavari incised in Deccan basalt at Nashik: channel stable at site scale

properties.name: Agastya's ashram (north)
properties.text_clue: Two yojanas from Panchavati
properties.identification: Agasti temple, Akole, on the Pravara (tradition only)

properties.name: Janasthana
properties.text_clue: Khara's district around Panchavati
properties.identification: Nashik region (no specific site; city centre as stand-in)

properties.name: Pampa lake and Matanga's ashram
properties.text_clue: Lake reached travelling west from Kabandha; Matanga's ashram on its west bank; Rishyamuka 'in front of' it
properties.identification: Pampa Sarovar near Hampi / Anegundi
properties.paleo_note: Tungabhadra in a granite-bedrock gorge: stable at site scale

properties.name: Rishyamuka hill
properties.text_clue: Sugriva's refuge hill near Pampa
properties.identification: Rishyamukha hill across the Tungabhadra from Hampi

properties.name: Kishkindha
properties.text_clue: Vali and Sugriva's cave-city near Rishyamuka and Prasravana
properties.identification: Anegundi on the Tungabhadra
properties.paleo_note: Tungabhadra in a granite-bedrock gorge: stable at site scale

properties.name: Prasravana hill on Malyavat
properties.text_clue: Rama's monsoon camp on the back of Malyavat, not far from Kishkindha
properties.identification: Malyavanta Raghunatha temple hill, Hampi

properties.name: Malaya mountain (Agastya's peak)
properties.text_clue: Agastya seated on the summit of Malaya, south of the Kaveri, before the Tamraparni
properties.identification: Agastya Mala (Pothigai), 1,868 m, southern Western Ghats

properties.name: Tamraparni river (mouth)
properties.text_clue: Great river with crocodiles, island-studded, entering the sea; crossed after Malaya
properties.identification: Thamirabarani river mouth at Punnakayal, Thoothukudi district
properties.paleo_note: Delta prograded 7.5-8 km in ~2,000 yr. In the 1st millennium BCE the mouth was near Korkai, about 7.5 km west of today's (epoch coordinate 8.633°N, 78.067°E)

properties.name: Golden gate (kavata) of the Pandyas
properties.text_clue: Golden pearl-studded gate of the Pandyas, after the Tamraparni and before the sea
properties.identification: Korkai, the early-historic Pandya pearl port near the Thamirabarani mouth (now inland)
properties.paleo_note: Korkai was a coastal pearl port from the 3rd century BCE to the 5th century CE; now about 7.5 km inland

properties.name: Golden gate (kavata) of the Pandyas — alternative: Madurai (translator's gloss)
Mahendra mountain
properties.text_clue: Set by Agastya at the sea, 'plunging into the ocean'; Hanuman's launch point; Rama climbs it and sees the sea
properties.identification: Mahendragiri, Tirunelveli-Kanyakumari border: summit 1,654 m (GEBCO 1,555 m)

alternatives.name: Mahendragiri, Odisha (the Puranic Mahendra kula-parvata)
alternatives.note: fits Kishkindha 41's east-coast list, not the southern-sea episode

properties.name: Mahendra mountain — alternative: Mahendragiri, Odisha (the Puranic Mahendra kula-parvata)
properties.note: fits Kishkindha 41's east-coast list, not the southern-sea episode

properties.name: Southern ocean shore (army camp)
properties.text_clue: The army reaches the shore forest (velavana) of the southern ocean after Mahendra
properties.identification: Kanyakumari (Cape Comorin), the shore nearest Mahendragiri
properties.paleo_note: Rocky cape: shoreline essentially fixed through the Holocene (GEBCO: <1 km change between -10 m and +1.5 m)

properties.name: Setu: Indian end
properties.text_clue: Causeway 100 yojanas long and 10 wide built by Nala 'in the middle of the ocean'
properties.identification: Arichal Munai, tip of the Dhanushkodi spit: western end of Adam's Bridge (Rama Setu)
properties.paleo_note: Spit and cays are mobile sand up to +3.5 m. During the +1.5-2 m highstand (6.5-5.5 ka) they were mostly awash, so the dry Indian end was the Rameswaram island core near 9.227°N, 79.340°E

properties.name: Setu: Indian end — alternative: Ramanathaswamy temple, Rameswaram ('Setubandha', vulgate 6.126 only)
Setu: Indian end — alternative: Thiruppullani / Darbhasayanam (mainland tradition)
Setu: Indian end — alternative: Devipattinam / Navapashanam (mainland tradition)
Setu: Indian end — alternative: Kodiakkarai Ramar Padam (Point Calimere tradition)
Setu: Lanka end
properties.text_clue: The causeway reaches the far shore
properties.identification: Talaimannar, west tip of Mannar island: eastern end of Adam's Bridge
properties.paleo_note: Mannar island is a low sand-and-reef island; its west tip migrates with the littoral drift

properties.name: Lanka (the island)
properties.text_clue: Island beyond Mahendra across the southern ocean, 'a full 100 yojanas' away, itself '100 yojanas long'
properties.identification: Sri Lanka (geographic centre): the only island off the Tamraparni/Pandya coast joined to it by a shoal
properties.paleo_note: Joined to India by land until sea level rose above the bridge sill (crest ~-3 m: c. 5200 BCE; rock ~-10 m: c. 6000 BCE)

properties.name: Lanka city on Trikuta: candidate A
properties.text_clue: City on the summit of Trikuta, seen from Suvela 'as if hanging in the sky'
properties.identification: Central highlands: Sri Pada (Adam's Peak), fabled as Trikuta; 2,243 m

properties.name: Lanka city on Trikuta: candidate B
properties.text_clue: Name-based link Trikuta ~ Tiru-kona-malai
properties.identification: Koneswaram on Swami Rock, Trincomalee (GEBCO ~30 m: not a mountain)

properties.name: Ashoka Vatika tradition: Seetha Amman temple
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Ashoka Vatika tradition: Seetha Amman temple: Sita Eliya / Hakgala

properties.name: Ravana Ella falls / cave tradition
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Ravana Ella falls / cave tradition: Ella

properties.name: Vibhishana tradition: Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Vibhishana tradition: Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara: near Colombo

properties.name: Ritigala (Sanjivani tradition)
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Ritigala (Sanjivani tradition): 766 m isolated massif

properties.name: Sigiriya (Ravana-palace folk tradition)
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Sigiriya (Ravana-palace folk tradition): 5th-century CE fortress

properties.name: Ussangoda (Hanuman-fire tradition)
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Ussangoda (Hanuman-fire tradition): south coast

properties.name: Rumassala (Sanjivani tradition)
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Rumassala (Sanjivani tradition): Galle

properties.name: Wariyapola (Pushpaka airfield tradition)
properties.text_clue: Sri Lankan Ramayana-trail tradition
properties.identification: Wariyapola (Pushpaka airfield tradition): Kurunegala

properties.name: Surya Siddhanta 'Lanka' (equator on Ujjain's meridian)
properties.text_clue: Zero point of Indian astronomy: equator on the meridian of Ujjain
properties.identification: Open ocean, 4,128 m deep (GEBCO): never land at any Quaternary sea level

properties.name: Maldives hypothesis
properties.text_clue: Proposed on long-yojana distance readings
properties.identification: Male atoll: separated from India by a 2,592 m deep sill (GEBCO)

properties.name: Central-India hypothesis (M. V. Kibe)
properties.text_clue: Lanka at the Narmada source in the Amarkantak hills
properties.identification: Amarkantak plateau: landlocked, ~700 km from the sea

properties.name: Equator x Ujjain meridian at the Puranic end of Treta (~869 ka)
properties.text_clue: Lanka placed where Ujjain's meridian meets the equator
properties.identification: Today's location of that point after India-plate motion since 869 ka: open ocean, 4,308 m deep (GEBCO)
properties.coord_source: Computed: NNR-MORVEL56 rotation of (0°, Ujjain's then-longitude)

properties.name: Equatorial ridge candidate A: Huvadhu atoll plateau
properties.valmiki_refs: Treta hypothesis (equatorial Lanka on the Chagos-Laccadive ridge)
properties.text_clue: Largest land within 300 km of the equator at the Treta sea level (-90 m)
properties.identification: Huvadhu atoll (Maldives) as an exposed limestone plateau: 3,737 km2, ~216 m above the Treta sea; 949 km from Mahendragiri (100 yojanas at 9.5 km); 2,286 m-deep sill to India

properties.name: Equatorial ridge candidate B: Fuvahmulah plateau
properties.text_clue: Second equatorial landmass at the Treta sea level
properties.identification: Fuvahmulah (Maldives): 39 km2, ~109 m above the Treta sea; 1,065 km from Mahendragiri; channel to Huvadhu 1,995 m deep

properties.name: Equatorial ridge candidate C: Addu atoll plateau
properties.text_clue: Third equatorial landmass at the Treta sea level
properties.identification: Addu atoll (Maldives): 206 km2, ~151 m above the Treta sea; 1,104 km from Mahendragiri; channel to Fuvahmulah 1,901 m deep

properties.name: Drowned island: Great Chagos Bank
properties.text_clue: Land at -90 m that is now reef and lagoon
properties.identification: ~14,550 km2 limestone island at the Treta sea level (-90 m); reduced to reef ~10-8 ka by post-glacial sea-level rise; 5.6 km2 of islets today

properties.name: Drowned island: Pitt Bank
properties.text_clue: Land at -90 m that is now wholly submerged
properties.identification: ~2,180 km2 at -90 m; drowned ~7.3 ka; no land today

properties.name: Drowned island: Speakers Bank
properties.text_clue: Land at -90 m that is now submerged
properties.identification: ~980 km2 at -90 m; drowned ~8.1 ka; negligible land today

properties.name: Near-circular abyssal basin (unexplained in GEBCO)
properties.text_clue: Closed, near-circular basin with a slightly raised margin
properties.identification: ~2,000 km2, 466 m deep below its rim at ~4,000 m depth; margin +32 m; needs a ship survey (GEBCO here is gravity-interpolated)

properties.name: Near-circular abyssal basin (unexplained in GEBCO)
properties.text_clue: Closed, near-circular basin with a slightly raised margin
properties.identification: ~1,600 km2, 459 m deep below its rim at ~4,100 m depth; margin +75 m; needs a ship survey

properties.name: Kumari Kandam test: Wadge Bank shelf south of Kanyakumari
properties.valmiki_refs: (Tamil tradition of lands lost south of Kumari)
properties.text_clue: Land said to have stretched south of Kanyakumari before the sea took it
properties.identification: Real drowned land: ~8,600 km2 of shelf south of Kanyakumari was dry at the Treta sea level (-90 m), reaching only to ~7.4 N; beyond it the sea floor falls to 2,400 m at 6 N and 4,800 m at the equator (GEBCO)

properties.name: Drowned plain of the Palk Bay
properties.text_clue: Dry land joining India and Sri Lanka at low sea level
properties.identification: ~26,000 km2 of plain between India and Sri Lanka, dry whenever the sea stood more than ~10 m below today

properties.name: Mauritius (tested as Lanka)
properties.text_clue: Island proposed by some as Lanka
properties.identification: Volcanic island < 9 Myr old over the buried microcontinent 'Mauritia'; 20 S, 3,804 km from Mahendragiri (100 yojanas = 38 km each); the three-peaked Trois Mamelles is a coincidence of shape

properties.name: Reunion (Mascarene hotspot island)
properties.text_clue: Active hotspot volcano of the Mascarenes
properties.identification: Summit 3,070 m; 4,039 km from Mahendragiri; barely larger at the Treta sea level

properties.name: Drowned island: Saya de Malha Bank
properties.text_clue: Bank that was a large island at low sea level
properties.identification: ~18,500 km2 of land at the Treta sea level (-90 m), ~29,000 km2 at -128 m; no land today (NOAA ETOPO 2022)

properties.name: Drowned island: Nazareth Bank
properties.text_clue: Bank that was a large island at low sea level
properties.identification: ~15,000 km2 of land at -90 m; no land today (NOAA ETOPO 2022)
